# (7) substitution_chain — MANDATORY ([CHAIN] trigger: the δτ_amp → h_par derivation, with a directional "raises δτ_amp toward the steady envelope" claim)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "the physical S66 Volovik-tracking V_eff (which settles the modulus at τ_fold) raises the
            residual ring-down amplitude δτ_amp from the S111 one-period heuristic (1.842e-3) toward
            the steady-envelope value, assembling h_par = δτ_amp · (d ln E²/dτ) closer to the
            guard-floor 8.3e-4."

    Definition 1: h_par := (d ω_n²/dτ) · δτ_amp / ω_{n,0}² = δτ_amp · (d ln E_n²/dτ)
                  [inv-12 W3-2 Mathieu normal form Ω_k²(t)=E_k²[1+h_par cos(ω_q t)]; s111_cf_floquet3 docstring eq.]
    Definition 2: (d ln E_n²/dτ) = d(λ_n²)/dτ / E_n²  at the near-a=1 relic mode = 0.14980
                  [s111 npz s_near1; CACHED from s84_spectrum_cache_L12; Δ_BCS τ-independent so dE²/dτ=dλ²/dτ; INVARIANT under the V_eff change — same spectral leg]
    Definition 3: δτ_amp := late-time settled ring-down envelope of the coupled ODE
                  τ̈ + 3H τ̇ + dV_eff/dτ = 0 ,  H²=(1/3)[(1/2)τ̇²+V_eff(τ)]
                  with V_eff = S66 Volovik-tracking (minimum at τ_fold)
                  [REPLACES the S111 one-period heuristic δτ_amp = A_launch·exp(−γT) = 1.842e-3]
    Definition 4: guard-floor target h_par = 8.3e-4  [S101-W1-QEQ-RELIC-ODDFLOOR pin; 10% band = its own tolerance]

    Substitute: h_par_derived = δτ_amp(V_eff^{Volovik}) · 0.14980
                metric        = |h_par_derived − 8.3e-4| / 8.3e-4

    Simplify (PASS-band inversion): h_par_derived = 8.3e-4  ⟺  δτ_amp = 8.3e-4 / 0.14980 = 5.541e-3
                The PASS band δτ_amp ∈ [8.3e-4·0.90/0.14980, 8.3e-4·1.10/0.14980] = [4.987e-3, 6.095e-3]

    Canonical form: ∂h_par/∂δτ_amp = (d ln E²/dτ) = +0.14980 > 0   (h_par strictly increasing in δτ_amp)

    Direction:  ∂h_par/∂δτ_amp = +0.14980 > 0  ⇒  h_par increases with δτ_amp. The S111 heuristic
                δτ_amp = 1.842e-3 gave h_par = 2.76e-4 (factor-3.01 LOW). The physical Volovik-tracking
                V_eff settles the modulus WITHOUT runaway: whether the settled δτ_amp rises into the
                PASS band [4.987e-3, 6.095e-3] (factor ~2.7–3.3 above the one-period heuristic) is the
                gate's OPEN test — the direction (settling raises δτ_amp vs the runaway-forced heuristic
                that truncated at one period) is the predicted sign, the magnitude is the computed output.
    Conclusion: PASS iff |h_par_derived − 8.3e-4|/8.3e-4 ≤ 0.10 (δτ_amp lands [4.987e-3, 6.095e-3]),
                upgrading h_par from guard-floor-ASSERTED to substrate-DERIVED; INFO if 0.10 < metric
                ≤ 1.0 (corridor narrowed, h_par stays asserted-but-physically-motivated); FAIL if
                metric > 1.0 (settled δτ_amp not within a factor of 2 — the "δτ_amp recoverable from
                a physical-V_eff modulus afterglow" corridor closes). NON-BLOCKING throughout: §VII.BP
                DEAD needs only h_par ≪ 14/193 = 0.0725, which EVERY reading satisfies emphatically.

## Wave 3 Execution Notes

- **Python**: `"phonon-exflation-sim/.venv312/Scripts/python.exe"` (ROCm torch 2.9.1 + RX 9070 XT). B5A-BRACKETED uses `torch.linalg` for the 166896-mode L12 bulk-EE cumulative sums (≥100); FLOQUET3 uses the OMP8 CPU cap for the 2-component coupled ODE (small system) and reads the spectral-sensitivity leg from the L12 cache (no new diagonalization).
- **Output**: `computations/session-112/` (scripts `s112_cf_b5a_bracketed.py`, `s112_cf_floquet3_hpar_tighten.py`; verdict file; npz; png).
- **Verdict emission**: each script PRINTS the `print_verdict_payload` block; the dispatched agent calls `mcp__knowledge__emit_verdict(**payload)` (race-safe, lock-serialized). Both gates carry the `[SIGN]`/`[CHAIN]`-with-direction 3-tuple (sign/magnitude/regime) per schema-v2.
- **Anti-tautology discipline (B5A)**: the `S_gen == A/4` crossing (`R_island_QES = 0.9868`) is FORBIDDEN as the canonical value (it forces R=1 by construction); it is reported diagnostic-only. The canonical landing is `R(f_bulk)` with `f_bulk` the DERIVED causal-patch fraction. No iterate-until-PASS: the bracket endpoints and the f_bulk definition are pinned pre-result.
- **NON-BLOCKING (FLOQUET3)**: §VII.BP DEAD is unaffected by any verdict — it requires only `h_par ≪ 14/193 = 0.0725`, which every reading (1.4e-4 to 2.8e-4, and any settled-V_eff value in the same decade) satisfies. PASS/INFO/FAIL is corridor-narrowing, not status-changing.
- Each gate writes results ONLY to its designated section in `sessions/session-112/session-112-w3-workingpaper.md`.
- No TeamCreate — each gate dispatches as an independent Agent-tool call to its `agent_type` specialist (hawking-theorist; transit-dynamics-theorist).
